Further following additional provisions are added in the certification and verification of local content provision of the Preference to Make in India clause: i. In case of foreign bidder, certificate from the statutory auditor or cost auditor of their own office or subsidiary in India giving the percentage of local content is also acceptable. In case office or subsidiary in India does not exist or Indian office/subsidiary is not required to appoint statutory auditor or cost auditor, certificate from practicing cost accountant or practicing chartered accountant giving the percentage of local content is also acceptable. ii. Along with Each Invoice: The local content certificate (issued by statutory auditor on behalf of procuring company) shall be submitted along with each invoice raised. However, the % of local content may vary with each invoice while maintaining the overall % of local content for the total work/purchase of the pro-rata local content requirement. In case, it is not satisfied cumulatively in the invoices raised up to that stage, the supplier shall indicate how the local content requirement would be met in the subsequent stages. iii. The bidder shall submit an undertaking from the authorized signatory of bidder having the Power of Attorney along with the bid stating the bidder meets the mandatory minimum LC requirement and such undertaking shall become a part of the contract. 12. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Technical Specifications for miRNA Sequencing of Milk-Derived Exosomes · Sample type: Purified milk-derived exosomes in Trizol. · Exosomal RNA Extraction: High-efficiency extraction of total RNA enriched for small RNA/miRN A. · Library Preparation: Small RNA library preparation for capturing of miRNAs, piRNAs, snoRNAs a nd snRNAs; Incorporation of Unique Molecular Identifiers/random adapters to ensure accurate digit al c ounting of low-abundance miRNAs. · Sequencing Platform: Illumina NovaSeq 6000/NextSeq 2000/equivalent Illumina platform: Singl e-end 50 bp (SE50) sequencing. · Sequencing Depth: Minimum 15–20 million reads per sample with ≥85% bases having Q30 or h igher quality score; >99.9% base calling accuracy. · Quality Control: Service provider should provide RNA Quality assessment, size profiling quality report; Library QC—Quantification and size validation; Adapter contamination statistics, Read quali ty, GC content, Duplication rate, (UMI deduplication) and Mapping statistics. · Deliverable: Raw Data QC, alignment against Reference genome and miRBase using standard ali gners (≥70% mapping rate to reference genome/miRNA database), miRNA Identification (known a s well as novel); differential expression analysis. · Raw data should be supplied on external hard drive/cloud storage along with standard demultiple xed sequencing data in standard FASTQ format, BAM, Count matrix and annotation files. General Requirements: · The bidder should have expertise in small RNA sequencing of extracellular vesicles/exosomes and must have successfully completed at least three comparable projects involving exosomal RNA seq uencing. · Completion of data generation and preliminary bioinformatic reporting within 3 to 4 weeks from t he receipt of quality-cleared samples.

· All biological material, raw data, processed files, and analytical outputs remain the sole property of the IO/institute. No data shall be shared or stored publicly by the vendor without written authori zation. · Payment will be released upon submission of satisfactory QC reports, complete FASTQ raw data, and bioinformatic anaysis reports. . 20.
